newsitem.title: UK: LME's King sees beefing-up of SIB as 'bold' move.
newsitem.headline: LME's King sees beefing-up of SIB as 'bold' move.

text.p: David King, chief-executive of the London Metal Exchange (LME), welcomed Tuesday's news that Chancellor Gordon Brown had enhanced the powers of Britain's leading regulator the Securities and Investment Board (SIB).
King, attending the Metal Bulletin copper conference in Seville, Spain, said "My personal view is that these steps are bold and positive for the market,"

But King stressed that this was his personal view based on the limited information available in Seville and that he would need to study the changes and consult with colleagues on his return to London.

The LME has this year adopted and set target dates for recommendations made by the SIB after a wide-ranging review of the Exchange following a $1.8 billion copper trading loss made by a senior trader at Japan's Sumitomo Corp in 1996.
